description: Advanced unmanaged Android build diagnostic. A bare call starts nothing and steers to `ceraph_start({ platform: 'android', rebuild: true })`. Set `unmanaged:true` only when you accept responsibility for the build process. `clean:true` may regenerate the Android native project for Expo apps.

device.description: Exact adb serial, such as emulator-5554.

projectDir.description: React Native/Expo project directory. Omit when the coding client's workspace identifies one app; supply it to disambiguate projects.

variant.description: Exact debuggable Gradle variant, such as developmentDebug.

name: rn_build_android
